spec.description: Macro system load. Tells you WHEN macro spikes happen across the server
spec.title: Fleet Total IRQ Rate (IRQs/sec)

options.content:
### 📖 IRQ Observability & Category Reference Primer

| Category | Devices & Subsystems Included | Purpose & Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Network** | `eth*`, `ena*`, `vfio*` | High-throughput NIC Rx/Tx queue interrupts. Primary source of network traffic latency. |
| **Storage** | `nvme*`, `sd*`, `ahci*` | NVMe controller and disk I/O queues. |
| **Accelerator** | `qat*` (Intel QAT), `idxd*` (Intel DSA), `fpga*` | Hardware offload engines for crypto, compression, and direct memory streaming. |
| **System** | `timer`, `rtc`, `acpi`, `IOMMU`, `dmar`, `pciehp`, `PME`, `IO-APIC`, `ttyS*`, `smbus` | Platform clocks, VT-d DMA remapping, power management, and PCIe bus maintenance. |
| **Other** | Unmapped hardware interrupts | Uncategorized kernel interrupts. |

---

* **Reporting Modes (`$report_type`)**: 
  * `active_1s`: Real-time 1-second active telemetry (`rate > 0`) for DevOps microburst detection.
  * `full_1m`: 1-minute complete compliance snapshot (includes idle `0`-rate IRQs) for trading team isolation verification.
* **Metric Headers**: `rate` represents **IRQs/second**; `cumulative_count` represents total accumulated interrupts **since server boot**.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT 
  count(DISTINCT hostname) AS "Reporting Hosts"
FROM system_irq_telemetry
WHERE timestamp > dateadd('m', -2, now())
  AND report_type = '$report_type';

SELECT 
  timestamp,
  hostname,
  irq_id,
  CASE 
    WHEN device_name LIKE '%eth%' OR device_name LIKE '%ena%' OR device_name LIKE '%vfio%' THEN 'Network'
    WHEN device_name LIKE '%nvme%' OR device_name LIKE '%sd%' OR device_name LIKE '%ahci%' THEN 'Storage'
    WHEN device_name LIKE '%qat%' OR device_name LIKE '%idxd%' OR device_name LIKE '%fpga%' OR device_name LIKE '%accel%' THEN 'Accelerator'
    WHEN device_name LIKE '%timer%' OR device_name LIKE '%rtc%' OR device_name LIKE '%acpi%' OR device_name LIKE '%IOMMU%' OR device_name LIKE '%dmar%' OR device_name LIKE '%pciehp%' OR device_name LIKE '%PME%' OR device_name LIKE '%IO-APIC%' OR device_name LIKE '%tty%' OR device_name LIKE '%smbus%' THEN 'System'
    ELSE 'Other'
  END AS category,
  device_name,
  configured_affinity,
  active_cpus,
  rate AS "rate (/sec)",
  cumulative_count AS "cumulative_count (since boot)"
FROM system_irq_telemetry
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND hostname IN ($hostname)
  AND report_type = '$report_type'
  AND rate > 0
  AND (
    '$irq_type' = 'All' OR 
    CASE 
      WHEN device_name LIKE '%eth%' OR device_name LIKE '%ena%' OR device_name LIKE '%vfio%' THEN 'Network'
      WHEN device_name LIKE '%nvme%' OR device_name LIKE '%sd%' OR device_name LIKE '%ahci%' THEN 'Storage'
      WHEN device_name LIKE '%qat%' OR device_name LIKE '%idxd%' OR device_name LIKE '%fpga%' OR device_name LIKE '%accel%' THEN 'Accelerator'
      WHEN device_name LIKE '%timer%' OR device_name LIKE '%rtc%' OR device_name LIKE '%acpi%' OR device_name LIKE '%IOMMU%' OR device_name LIKE '%dmar%' OR device_name LIKE '%pciehp%' OR device_name LIKE '%PME%' OR device_name LIKE '%IO-APIC%' OR device_name LIKE '%tty%' OR device_name LIKE '%smbus%' THEN 'System'
      ELSE 'Other'
    END = '$irq_type'
  )
LATEST ON timestamp PARTITION BY hostname, irq_id
ORDER BY "rate (/sec)" DESC;

| :--- | :--- | :--- |

| **Storage** | `nvme*`, `sd*`, `ahci*` | NVMe controller and disk I/O queues. |
| **Accelerator** | `qat*` (Intel QAT), `idxd*` (Intel DSA), `fpga*` | Hardware offload engines for crypto, compression, and direct memory streaming. |
| **System** | `timer`, `rtc`, `acpi`, `IOMMU`, `dmar`, `pciehp`, `PME`, `IO-APIC`, `ttyS*`, `smbus` | Platform clocks, VT-d DMA remapping, power management, and PCIe bus maintenance. |

spec.rawSql:
SELECT 
  count(DISTINCT hostname) AS "Reporting Hosts"
FROM system_irq_telemetry
WHERE timestamp > dateadd('m', -2, now())
  AND report_type = '$report_type';

SELECT 
  timestamp AS time,
  metric,
  sum(rate) AS "Rate/s"
FROM (
  SELECT 
    timestamp,
    hostname,
    rate,
    concat('IRQ ', cast(irq_id as string), ' (', device_name, ')') AS metric,
    CASE 
      WHEN device_name LIKE '%eth%' OR device_name LIKE '%ena%' OR device_name LIKE '%vfio%' THEN 'Network'
      WHEN device_name LIKE '%nvme%' OR device_name LIKE '%sd%' OR device_name LIKE '%ahci%' THEN 'Storage'
      WHEN device_name LIKE '%qat%' OR device_name LIKE '%idxd%' OR device_name LIKE '%fpga%' OR device_name LIKE '%accel%' THEN 'Accelerator'
      WHEN device_name LIKE '%timer%' OR device_name LIKE '%rtc%' OR device_name LIKE '%acpi%' OR device_name LIKE '%IOMMU%' OR device_name LIKE '%dmar%' OR device_name LIKE '%pciehp%' OR device_name LIKE '%PME%' OR device_name LIKE '%IO-APIC%' OR device_name LIKE '%tty%' OR device_name LIKE '%smbus%' THEN 'System'
      ELSE 'Other'
    END AS category
  FROM system_irq_telemetry
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND hostname IN ($hostname)
    AND report_type = '$report_type'
)
WHERE ('$irq_type' = 'All' OR category = '$irq_type')
SAMPLE BY $__interval ALIGN TO CALENDAR;

spec.rawSql:
SELECT 
  concat(hostname, ' | IRQ ', cast(irq_id as string), ' | ', device_name) AS metric,
  sum(rate) AS "Total Interrupts"
FROM system_irq_telemetry
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND hostname IN ($hostname)
  AND report_type = 'active_1s'
  AND (
    '$irq_type' = 'All' OR 
    CASE 
      WHEN device_name LIKE '%eth%' OR device_name LIKE '%ena%' OR device_name LIKE '%vfio%' THEN 'Network'
      WHEN device_name LIKE '%nvme%' OR device_name LIKE '%sd%' OR device_name LIKE '%ahci%' THEN 'Storage'
      WHEN device_name LIKE '%qat%' OR device_name LIKE '%idxd%' OR device_name LIKE '%fpga%' OR device_name LIKE '%accel%' THEN 'Accelerator'
      WHEN device_name LIKE '%timer%' OR device_name LIKE '%rtc%' OR device_name LIKE '%acpi%' OR device_name LIKE '%IOMMU%' OR device_name LIKE '%dmar%' OR device_name LIKE '%pciehp%' OR device_name LIKE '%PME%' OR device_name LIKE '%IO-APIC%' OR device_name LIKE '%tty%' OR device_name LIKE '%smbus%' THEN 'System'
      ELSE 'Other'
    END = '$irq_type'
  )
GROUP BY hostname, irq_id, device_name
ORDER BY "Total Interrupts" DESC
LIMIT 25;
